title: Blockdrive
tagline: Blockdrive is a desktop application and command-line tool that allows users to upload and download files using IPFS as an alternative to traditional cloud storage providers such as OneDrive.
description:
Currently, many file storage solutions such as OneDrive and Google Drive store your files on a single server, which makes them vulnerable to cyber threats such as data breaches and hacking attacks. Additionally, if the server experiences downtime or malfunctions, you will not be able to access your files.

BlockDrive solves this problem by providing a decentralized file storage solution. By storing your files in a distributed network, BlockDrive ensures that your files are safe from cyber threats and data breaches. Additionally, since your files are stored in a decentralized network, you can access them from anywhere, anytime, and on any device.

Another problem that BlockDrive solves is the issue of limited storage space. With centralized file storage solutions, you are often limited by the amount of storage space available on the server. With BlockDrive, you can store an unlimited amount of data, as long as you have the capacity to store it on your device.

What makes our project special

- we utilized lighthouse sdk to make the data perpetual
- our software updates the registries thereby having a button in the context menu , to seemelessly upload any file with just right clicking on it
- upload on file structure change: any file that is added to blockdrive folder will directly be uploaded into ipfs , thereby making it very easy for users to upload by just dragging and drop
- queing when internet is slow, when user send the file into blockchain folder , the upload is queued and upload happens in background when ever internet is connected

In summary, BlockDrive solves the problems of centralized file storage by providing a decentralized and secure solution, and by offering unlimited storage space. With BlockDrive, you can store your files safely, access them from anywhere, and enjoy peace of mind knowing that your files are safe and secure.
